lumar-inn.label: WINDOW
lumar-inn.prompt: PRESS E TO SIT IN THE WINDOW
lumar-inn.caption:
THE WINDOW SEAT, CUSHIONED AND WARM FROM THE FIRE.

PAST THE ROOFTOPS OF THE SQUARE: THE SEA, AND THE MOON LAID ACROSS IT. A LANTERN POST FLICKERS BELOW.

lumar-inn.label: ARMCHAIR
lumar-inn.dialog: A DEEP ARMCHAIR BY THE FIRE. THE WARMTH SOAKS INTO YOUR BONES, AND THE NOISE OF THE ROOM GOES SOFT.

lumar-inn.label: ARMCHAIR
lumar-inn.dialog: A DEEP ARMCHAIR BY THE FIRE. SOMEONE HAS LEFT A BOOK OF SEA SHANTIES ON THE ARM, OPEN AT A RUDE ONE.

lumar-house.label: ARMCHAIR
lumar-house.dialog: THE CARTOGRAPHER'S READING CHAIR. THE CUSHION REMEMBERS THE SHAPE OF SOMEONE SMALLER THAN YOU.

lumar-tavern.label: STOOL
lumar-tavern.dialog: A STOOL AT THE BAR, WOBBLING ON ONE SHORT LEG. THE BARTENDER SLIDES A MUG YOUR WAY WITHOUT ASKING.

lumar-tavern.label: STOOL
lumar-tavern.dialog: A STOOL AT THE END OF THE BAR, NEAR THE FIRE. GOOD FOR LISTENING TO EVERYONE AT ONCE.

lumar-tavern.label: STOOL
lumar-tavern.dialog: A STOOL AT A TABLE CARVED WITH A HUNDRED INITIALS. ONE OF THEM IS A SHIP MARK.

lumar-tavern.label: STOOL
lumar-tavern.dialog: A STOOL AT A TABLE BY THE WALL. A GAME OF DICE WAS ABANDONED HERE MID-ROLL.

lumar-square.label: BENCH
lumar-square.dialog: A BENCH BY THE FOUNTAIN. PIGEONS - OR SOMETHING LIKE PIGEONS - GATHER HOPEFULLY AT YOUR FEET.

lumar-square.label: BENCH
lumar-square.dialog: A BENCH IN THE SQUARE. THE BELL TOWER CHIMES THE QUARTER HOUR, A LITTLE FLAT.

lumar-sapphire.label: LOOKOUT
lumar-sapphire.prompt: PRESS E TO SIT AND LOOK

lumar-sapphire.label: BENCH
lumar-sapphire.dialog: A BENCH ON THE MARKET SQUARE. THE STALLHOLDERS CALL THEIR PRICES; NOBODY PAYS THEM.

lumar-sapphire.label: BENCH
lumar-sapphire.dialog: A BENCH BY THE SPICE STALL. YOUR EYES WATER PLEASANTLY.

lumar-sapphire-lighthouse.label: ROCKING CHAIR
lumar-sapphire-lighthouse.dialog: TAMSIN'S ROCKING CHAIR BY THE STOVE. IT CREAKS ONCE, CONTENTEDLY, AND ROCKS YOU WITHOUT BEING ASKED.

enigma-hydro.label: HAMMOCK
enigma-hydro.caption:
OKAFOR WAVES A HAND WITHOUT LOOKING UP. "GO ON. I NEVER USE IT."

THE GROW LIGHTS DIM TO NIGHT CYCLE. THE PUMPS HUM YOU UNDER.

chrome-clinic.label: RECOVERY BED
chrome-clinic.caption:
THE BED HUMS. A SOFT VOICE COUNTS YOU DOWN FROM TEN.

YOU DON'T REMEMBER SEVEN.

chrome-clinic.label: BENCH
chrome-clinic.dialog: THE WAITING BENCH. A SCREEN ABOVE IT SAYS 'NOW SERVING: 0'. IT HAS SAID THAT FOR A WHILE.

arcadia-street.label: BENCH
arcadia-street.dialog: A BENCH AT THE RAILING. BELOW IT THE CITY GOES DOWN AND DOWN, LIGHTS ALL THE WAY.

arcadia-street.label: BENCH
arcadia-street.dialog: A BENCH AT THE RAILING, WET WITH RAIN. A DELIVERY DRONE SITS AT THE OTHER END, RECHARGING.

arcadia.label: BENCH
arcadia.dialog: A BENCH FOR WAITING YOUR TURN. THE CABINETS BLEEP AT EACH OTHER IN THE DARK.

arcadia.label: BENCH
arcadia.dialog: A BENCH UNDER THE HIGH-SCORE BOARD. SOMEONE'S INITIALS ARE AT THE TOP OF EVERY LIST: 'NUL'.

tech-repair-shop.label: BENCH
tech-repair-shop.dialog: A BENCH FOR CUSTOMERS. A JAR OF LOOSE SCREWS SITS ON IT, LABELLED 'FREE (PROBABLY)'.

verdance.label: BENCH
verdance.dialog: YOUR PORCH BENCH. THE MILL TURNS, THE BEES WORK THE ORCHARD, AND FOR A WHILE NOTHING NEEDS DOING.

verdance.label: BENCH
verdance.dialog: HOLLIN'S BENCH, WORN SMOOTH. FROM HERE: THE POND, THE STALL, AND MARLO HAGGLING WITH A GOAT.

hoarfell-summit.label: BENCH
hoarfell-summit.prompt: PRESS E TO SIT AND LOOK
hoarfell-summit.caption:
THE BENCH AT THE TOP OF THE WORLD.

THE RANGE GOES ON PINK TO THE EDGE OF SIGHT, AND BELOW IT ALL, CLOUD - A WHOLE SEA OF IT, SLOW AS BREATHING.

hoarfell-summit.label: OBSERVATORY
hoarfell-summit.caption: THE OLD TELESCOPE STILL TURNS. UP HERE, ABOVE THE CLOUD, THE STARS DON'T EVEN TWINKLE.

hoarfell.label: BENCH
hoarfell.dialog: A BENCH BY THE POND, ITS SEAT SWEPT CLEAR. SOMEBODY'S ICE-FISHING LINE TWITCHES. THE CHAIRS CREAK UP THE MOUNTAIN, ONE BY ONE.

hoarfell-lodge.label: ARMCHAIR
hoarfell-lodge.dialog: THE RED CHAIR BY THE FIRE, WITH METTE'S KNITTING ON THE ARM. YOUR BOOTS START TO STEAM. BARLEY SIGHS IN HIS SLEEP.

hoarfell-lodge.label: ARMCHAIR
hoarfell-lodge.dialog: THE GREEN CHAIR, SAGGED INTO THE SHAPE OF A HUNDRED TIRED SKIERS. THE FIRE POPS. NOBODY NEEDS YOU FOR A WHILE.

arcadia-skywalk.label: BENCH
arcadia-skywalk.prompt: PRESS E TO SIT AND LOOK
arcadia-skywalk.caption:
A BENCH ON THE SKYWALK, STILL WET.

THE TOWERS GO UP INTO THE SMOG, THE ADS TALK TO NOBODY, AND THE TRAFFIC LANES SLIDE PAST BELOW YOUR FEET.

arcadia-skywalk.label: BENCH
arcadia-skywalk.prompt: PRESS E TO SIT AND LOOK
arcadia-skywalk.caption: B-SIDE PLAYS SOMETHING SLOW. THE RAIN KEEPS TIME ON THE GLASS.

arcadia-casino-dining.label: TABLE FOR TWO
arcadia-casino-dining.dialog: A TABLE FOR TWO BY THE WINDOW, A CANDLE, A WHITE CLOTH. TWO HUNDRED FLOORS DOWN, THE CITY GOES ON FOR EVER.

arcadia-casino-dining.label: TABLE FOR TWO
arcadia-casino-dining.dialog: A TABLE FOR TWO BY THE WINDOW, A CANDLE, A WHITE CLOTH. TWO HUNDRED FLOORS DOWN, THE CITY GOES ON FOR EVER.

arcadia-casino-dining.label: TABLE FOR TWO
arcadia-casino-dining.dialog: A TABLE FOR TWO UNDER THE CHANDELIERS. LAURENT WILL BRING THE MENU IF YOU ASK AT THE PODIUM.

arcadia-casino-dining.label: TABLE FOR TWO
arcadia-casino-dining.dialog: A TABLE FOR TWO UNDER THE CHANDELIERS. LAURENT WILL BRING THE MENU IF YOU ASK AT THE PODIUM.

arcadia-casino-dining.dialog: A TABLE FOR TWO UNDER THE CHANDELIERS. LAURENT WILL BRING THE MENU IF YOU ASK AT THE PODIUM.

arcadia-casino.label: LOUNGE CHAIR
arcadia-casino.dialog: A VELVET TUB CHAIR IN FRONT OF THE STAGE. LADY VELVET LEANS ON THE PIANO AND SINGS ABOUT A LUCKY STREAK THAT RAN OUT.

arcadia-casino.label: LOUNGE CHAIR
arcadia-casino.dialog: A VELVET TUB CHAIR IN FRONT OF THE STAGE. LADY VELVET LEANS ON THE PIANO AND SINGS ABOUT A LUCKY STREAK THAT RAN OUT.

arcadia-casino-vip.label: THE SOFA
arcadia-casino-vip.dialog: A LONG SOFA IN CRIMSON VELVET, FACING THE TABLES AND THE WHOLE CITY BEYOND THEM.

arcadia-casino-vip.label: THE WINDOW
arcadia-casino-vip.dialog: THE CROWN ROOM'S WINDOW: THE WHOLE OF ARCADIA, TOWER AFTER TOWER, THE TRAFFIC LANES LIKE STRINGS OF PEARLS.

arcadia-spires.label: BENCH
arcadia-spires.caption: THE POOL LIES BLACK AND STILL, AND THE STARS ARE IN IT. A REAL SKY, UPSIDE DOWN, AT YOUR FEET.

arcadia-spires.label: BENCH
arcadia-spires.caption: SOMEBODY HAS LEFT A PAPER BOAT ON THE POOL. IT TURNS SLOWLY THROUGH THE REFLECTED STARS.

arcadia-spires.label: BENCH
arcadia-spires.caption: THE CROWN FOUNTAIN PLAYS. WATER FALLS FROM GOLD INTO STONE, AND THE ONLY OTHER SOUND IS A LOOP TRAIN, VERY FAR BELOW, LIKE THE SEA.

arcadia-spires.label: BENCH
arcadia-spires.prompt: PRESS E TO SIT AND LOOK
arcadia-spires.caption: THE SMOG LIES BELOW LIKE A SEA AT NIGHT, LIT FROM UNDERNEATH. THE TOPS OF THE MID-LEVELS STAND OUT OF IT. ABOVE, THE STARS. REAL ONES.

arcadia-spires.label: BENCH
arcadia-spires.prompt: PRESS E TO SIT AND LOOK
arcadia-spires.caption: FAR OFF, ANOTHER SPIRE'S GOLD NEEDLE CATCHES THE MOON. SOMEONE OVER THERE IS PROBABLY LOOKING BACK.
